title: Number of Ways to Wear Different Hats to Each Other
summary: Determine the number of ways n individuals can each wear a unique hat from 40 available types, where each person prefers a subset of these hats.
statement: Determine the number of ways n individuals can each wear a unique hat from 40 available types, where each person prefers a subset of these hats. The result should be given modulo 10^9 + 7.
constraints: hats[i] lists distinct hats person i is willing to wear.
Assign every person one liked hat with no shared hat; return the count modulo 1,000,000,007.
hints: Represent assigned people as a bit mask.
Process hats rather than people so a hat can never be reused.
For each hat, either skip it or give it to one unassigned person who likes it.
The state (hat,mask) uniquely partitions all injective assignments.
editorial: The state (hat,mask) uniquely partitions all injective assignments.

tests.explanation: Only the assignment 3,4,5 gives all three people distinct liked hats.
Four ordered assignments choose distinct hats from the shared choices.
